title: MBESO2D: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material BESO
description: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization for two-dimensional problems, with retained-solid regions, line loads and self-weight. The revised-manuscript package adds brief teaching comments, an equation-to-code map, compact numerical data and editable MATLAB figure/table reproduction, plus separate scripts for fresh sensitivity, continuation and deadband-history experiments. These checks document the tested implementation and its limitations; they do not establish complete reproduction of the reference publication.
